channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Paris Imposes Nightly Curfew Amidst Riots and Protest Bans
item.description: Paris has imposed a nightly curfew in certain areas, effective until Monday morning, as authorities extend protest bans to cities like Marseille and Lyon. Protests are now restricted, with exceptions for those organized by unions… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Aung San Suu Kyi speaks with son after five years of imprisonment
item.description: Aung San Suu Kyi, the imprisoned former leader of Myanmar, has spoken with her son for the first time in five years. Her son reported that she sounded "fairly healthy" following the call. This event marks a significant breakthrough in… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: ICC Awarded Top EU Human Rights Prize Amidst Trump Criticism
item.description: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has been awarded the European Union's top human rights prize. The award comes amidst criticism from former US President Donald Trump. The EU recognized the ICC for its work in upholding human rights. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: YouTuber Charged for Illegally Capturing Great White Shark
item.description: A New York man, identified as a YouTuber, has been charged in connection with the illegal capture and dragging of a great white shark onto a beach on Cape Cod. The incident involved the shark being taken ashore, though further details on… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: American Stephen Hubbard Released from Russian Custody
item.description: American Stephen Hubbard has been released from Russian custody and has arrived in the United States. His son stated that Hubbard had been experiencing "extreme tiredness with life" prior to his release. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tesla Autopilot Involved in Fatal Pedestrian Accident
item.description: A 71-year-old pedestrian was killed on a California freeway when struck by a Tesla vehicle operating in self-driving mode. The incident is under investigation. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Quest Diagnostics Reports Cyber Breach Affecting Patient Records
item.description: Quest Diagnostics has reported a cyber breach that has affected certain patient records. The extent of the breach and the specific number of individuals impacted have not been disclosed. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Judges gain power to punish absent defendants in sentencing
item.description: Judges in the UK will be granted new powers to punish defendants who are absent from their sentencing hearings. This includes the ability to impose solitary confinement on killers who do not attend their sentencing. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Kieran Hayler Found Not Guilty of Rape
item.description: Kieran Hayler, ex-husband of Katie Price, has been found not guilty of rape. The verdict was delivered in court, and Hayler was seen speaking on the court steps following the decision. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Influencer Pleads Not Guilty to Rape Charge
item.description: Influencer Braden Peters, known online as Clavicular, has pleaded not guilty to a charge of rape. He is accused of sexually assaulting a 17-year-old girl in 2025. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Mother Alleges Police Misconduct During Coroner's Inquest
item.description: Regis Korchinski-Paquet's mother has made new allegations against police during a coroner's inquest into her daughter's death. These allegations reportedly caused chaos at the proceedings, with the mother stating, 'I know what I saw.' Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Toronto Crime Stoppers Halts Tips After Cyber Breach
item.description: Toronto Crime Stoppers has suspended its tip line following a cyber breach that compromised over 176,000 submissions. The organization paused operations after the data leak. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI-Powered Hacking Increases Online Safety Concerns
item.description: The increasing use of Artificial Intelligence in cyberattacks has heightened concerns about online safety, prompting advice on how individuals can protect themselves. Reports suggest that AI is being leveraged to supercharge hacking… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Israel Detains Activists During West Bank Olive Harvest
item.description: Israeli forces detained nearly 80 activists, including four Italians, who were assisting Palestinians with their olive harvest in the West Bank. The detentions occurred amidst reports of rising settler violence in the region. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Virginia State Senator Faces Federal Charges in Marijuana Business Case
item.description: Virginia State Senator has surrendered to federal authorities following an indictment related to a public corruption case. The senator is accused of shielding a marijuana business. In response, the senator stated they "will not be bullied"… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: New Zealand Military Chief Resigns Over Inappropriate Relationship
item.description: New Zealand Defence Force chief Tony Davies resigned on Friday after admitting to an undisclosed inappropriate relationship while in a unit command position. Davies stated he was taking responsibility for past errors in judgment. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump Ordered to Testify in $10 Billion BBC Defamation Lawsuit
item.description: A U.S. judge has ordered former President Donald Trump to provide a deposition by December 11 in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC. The lawsuit concerns the editing of a documentary about the January 6 Capitol riot. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: DRDO Employee Dies in Hyderabad After Altercation
item.description: A DRDO employee died in Hyderabad on Wednesday after allegedly being punched by his neighbour. The altercation reportedly stemmed from an allegation of misbehaviour by the deceased towards the neighbour's wife. Two cases have been… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Navy Tests Rafale Marine Jet for Aircraft Carrier Operations in Goa
item.description: The Indian Navy conducted trials of the Rafale Marine jet in Goa to validate its operational capabilities for deployment on the indigenous aircraft carrier INS Vikrant. A specialized ramp, designed to simulate the ski-jump of aircraft… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Six Dead, 40 Injured in Chhattisgarh Bus Accident
item.description: A bus carrying passengers in Chhattisgarh crashed into a roadside tree, resulting in the deaths of six people and injuring 40 others. The Chief Minister announced compensation for those affected. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: India Investigates Yacht Incident Off Yemen Coast
item.description: India is investigating an incident involving a yacht carrying 14 Indian nationals off the coast of Yemen. The Houthis have alleged that the incident was a Saudi attack. The Indian embassy has assured assistance to those affected. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: India Rejects UN Report on D-Company
item.description: India has rejected a United Nations report that identified the D-Company as an India-based criminal group. The government has stated its position on the matter. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Speeding Vehicle Kills Four Devotees in Andhra Pradesh
item.description: A speeding SUV struck and killed four devotees who had stopped for tea near the Kanaka Durga Temple in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh. The incident occurred as the devotees were on their way to the temple. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Bombay High Court Bans Firecrackers on Mumbai Roads, Cites Pollution
item.description: The Bombay High Court has banned the bursting of firecrackers on public roads in Mumbai, citing air pollution concerns. The court also directed civic and police authorities to develop an action plan to enforce the ban. This action follows… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: One Dead, Three Injured in Delhi Septic Tank Gas Leak
item.description: One person died and three others were injured in Chhawla, Delhi, due to suspected toxic gas exposure while working in a septic tank. The incident highlights the dangers associated with working in confined spaces like septic tanks. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Voter List Discrepancies Emerge in Delhi, UP, and Telangana
item.description: Concerns have been raised regarding voter list discrepancies in Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Telangana. In Delhi, 4,263 objections related to the 'Special Initiative Registration' (SIR) process are reported missing. The number of disposed… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Driving License Test Rules Set for Major Changes
item.description: The Indian government is proposing significant changes to the driving license system. Under the new rules, applicants will need to score at least 75% in online driving tests. The proposal also includes plans to issue driving licenses in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian students' bodies return from Germany after fatal fire
item.description: The bodies of Indian students Sivan and Anjali, who died in a fire in Bochum, Germany, have been brought back to India. The bodies arrived at Nedumbassery Airport in Kerala early Friday morning around 1:30 AM. Funeral rites are scheduled… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Pregnant Teen Allegedly Gang-Raped in Rajasthan, Newborn Dies
item.description: A pregnant minor was allegedly gang-raped in Rajasthan's Dausa district. The incident came to light when she reached a hospital with her newborn baby, who was declared dead by doctors. A Deputy Superintendent of Police has been assigned to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: ABP News fires 3 employees over fake Neha Singh Rathore video
item.description: ABP News has terminated the employment of three individuals following the broadcast of a fake video that falsely linked singer Neha Singh Rathore to a sex racket. The video, which was aired by the news channel, has been described as false… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Shiv Sena, Maratha Activist Seek Probe into Rs 500 Cr Audio Clip
item.description: Shiv Sena and Maratha reservation activist Manoj Jarange have demanded a forensic audit and a Special Investigation Team (SIT) probe into a viral audio clip. The clip allegedly discusses a payment of Rs 500 crore to end the Maratha… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Christian Families in Bengal Allege Assault and Threats to Renounce Faith
item.description: Three Christian families in a Bengal village have alleged they faced days of assault and threats to renounce their faith. One report states that their saris were removed and blouses torn. The families allege the Bajrang Dal played a role… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: BJP Worker Hacked and Shot Dead in Malda; Family Alleges TMC Involvement
item.description: Samir Ghosh, a Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) worker, was killed in Malda, West Bengal. He was reportedly hacked and shot at close range by a group of 11 individuals at his home. Malda police have arrested one suspect and are searching for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: CJP Leaders Fail to Appear Before Delhi Police, Seek More Time
item.description: CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka did not appear before the Delhi Police for questioning at the Rajouri Garden office as summoned. They have reportedly sought more time. Both leaders also have a court appearance scheduled for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Tiger Shroff's team shares video of injuries after alleged firing incident
item.description: Tiger Shroff's team has shared a video showing injuries on his arm, featuring red marks and small pellet-like wounds. The video was released four days after an alleged firing incident. The actor's team shared the update to address… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Election Commissioners' Complaint Against Senior Officer Revealed by RTI
item.description: An RTI query has revealed that two Election Commissioners, Dr. Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Dr. Vivek Joshi, lodged a complaint with the Cabinet Secretary against a senior officer, Manish Garg, a Senior Deputy Election Commissioner. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Four Accused in Tiger Shroff Shooting Case Remanded to Custody
item.description: Four individuals accused in the firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff's car have been remanded to police custody. Gangster Anil Pandit, associated with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, has been identified as the mastermind and declared a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: French Police Use New Stun Grenades on Protesters, Injuring Some
item.description: French police have continued to use new stun grenades during protests, resulting in injuries to demonstrators. The Economist noted that the government faces challenges in meeting the protesters' demands. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Manipur Violence: Three Dead, Protesters Bring Bodies to CM's Residence
item.description: Renewed violence in Manipur has resulted in three deaths, with protesters bringing the bodies to the Chief Minister's residence to demand action. The incident has sparked protests outside the CM's house. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Punjab CM Mann Claims Detention, Accuses Centre of Humiliation
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was reportedly detained at Delhi Airport for three hours upon his return from France, according to claims by the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP). AAP alleged that officials imposed a penalty of ₹50,000 on Mann… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 9 · Right 0.
